style.styleTitle: Personalised Photo Upload Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Whether it's baby's first Christmas or to remember someone who s no longer with us, you choose exactly what adorns this tree decoration by uploading your photograph and we will also include your message on the front and back of the bauble. Front Message Line 1 (front of the bauble) - 20 characters. Front Message Line 2 (front of the bauble) - 20 characters. Message Line 1 (reverse) - 20 characters. Message Line 2 (reverse) - 20 characters. Message Line 3 (reverse) - 20 characters. Message Line 4 (reverse) - 20 characters. Please note the personalisation will appear in fixed uppercase. 400159 37.5(W) x 37.5(H) - Image size (mm). Please ensure the image is of the highest quality as possible. Bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. Colour of ribbon may vary.
